company.name: Riyad Bank
company.shortDescription: Riyad Bank is an arabic financial institution for businesses and individuals.
company.description: Riyad Bank SJSC is a Saudi Arabia-based bank that provides banking and investment services. The Bank offers its services through four segments: the Retail segment covers deposit, credit and investment products for individuals and small to medium sized businesses; the Investment banking and brokerage segment provides investment management services and asset management activities related to dealing, managing, arranging, advising and custody of securities; the Corporate segment handles corporate customers’ current accounts and deposits, and provides loans, overdrafts and other credit facilities and derivative, the Treasury and Investments segment provides money market trading and treasury services, as well as the management of the Bank’s investment portfolios. The Bank also provides Islamic banking products to its customers.
